text:
Alex M: Quick thought — let's try a cadence to reduce meeting drag: two short hotfix lanes (morning + late afternoon) and a single midday backlog + micro-RFC slot. Goal: faster owner assignment and fewer follow-up syncs. Proposed times: 08:45 (15m), 12:30 (30m), 16:30 (15m).

Priya R: Sounds good. How do we decide who runs the hotfix lanes? keep oncall or volunteers?

Jamal T: Volunteers for the week, with a fallback single oncall. Suggest week-long volunteers rotate Mon->Mon so you have runway to ramp. Also volunteers pair up if possible.

Sofia L: Can the 12:30 half-hour be the catch-all for quick RFC/design reviews (5m max each)? Saves extra calendar churn.

Marta V: Yes. Also propose we add a very small agenda template so people know what to paste in the pre-read (repro steps, logs, PR link, impact).

Alex M: Agree on template. Draft: ```
1) Hotfix lane (15m) - quick triage, ship/rollback action, owner picks followup
2) Midday backlog + RFC (30m) - top 3 bugs by age/impact, 3-5m micro-RFC slots, assign owners
3) Late hotfix (15m) - clear remaining urgent items, confirm deploys
Pinned pre-read required 30m before meeting: repro, short logs link, PR/issue link, severity tag (#sev1/#sev2).```

Priya R: Can we run a 2-week pilot and collect metrics: avg time-to-assign, time-to-deploy for fixes, number of meetings scheduled outside triage? Also a quick anonymous pulse about meeting usefulness.

Jamal T: +1 to pilot. Rotation sketch: ```
Week A: Jamal + Sofia (volunteers)
Week B: Priya + Alex
Week C: Marta + Jamal
Fallback: oncall-primary```
We can wire this into calendar automation so invites are swapped each week.

triage-bot: Heads up: use `/triage volunteer <YYYY-MM-DD>` to claim a week. Add `#triage-volunteer` to the calendar event and I will update attendees automatically. I can also pin a pre-read thread if you include `!pin-preread` in the event description.

Sofia L: One more ask: the pinned pre-read should include a single-line TL;DR at top and a link to a short log dump (S3/Gist). Saves the first 5 minutes for everyone.

Marta V: I'll draft the calendar invite text + pre-read template and post to #eng today. I'll include the automation steps and the rota CSV we can drop into the calendar tool.

Alex M: Plan: - Marta posts invite + pre-read template (today) - Volunteers sign up by EOD Fri - Calendar automation tested next Mon - 2-week pilot starts next Wed. If no objections, I'll flip the calendar and tag the first volunteers.

Priya R: Quick ops question: for hotfix lanes, what counts as \"urgent\"? Can we add a checklist or definition in the invite?

Jamal T: Good call. Suggested definition in invite: \"Urgent = user-facing regression impacting >1% of requests OR critical data loss path OR security issue. For lower-impact bugs we put them in backlog slot.\"

Marta V: I'll add that to the invite and the pre-read template. Also adding a tiny checklist for owners: have PR link, run repro, confirm rollback plan, estimate fix time.

Alex M: Thanks all. If folks volunteer asap we'll automate calendars and pin the pre-read template. Two-week trial, then quick review at the end. :rocket:
